name: Koroshi no Dress
source:
Best friend's fiancé is found dead and naked at the park's toilet. Hero starts an investigation, but then the second murder occurs and his girlfriend disappears mysteriously.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/04/vn-of-year-1987.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
好友的未婚妻被人发现赤身裸体地死在公园厕所里。主人公开始调查案件，第二起谋杀却又接踵而至，他的女友也神秘失踪。

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/04/vn-of-year-1987.html]vndbreview[/url]]
